name: Sarah Mehrtens
story: Sarah Mehrtens of the New Zealand Geospatial Office reported in 2009 to the Geospatial Executives Group after a project involving an advisory group of twenty people from government, industry and academia. The group considered how standards were being developed and used and whether government needed a more deliberate coordination role.
